sequence.name: remote Git publication
sequence.mutation: Publish the already-identified candidate integration commit 5872284828f9dd6f0a75adf407becaeadb50d61a to the authorized remote main publication boundary; exact refspec and actor must be separately approved.
preconditions: candidate SHA is immutable and reviewed
Rule 24 storage gate is PASS/ not applicable to this Git-only publication
success_evidence: push receipt with remote ref and resulting SHA
read-only remote main verification equals candidate SHA
fail_closed: remote rejects or resolves to any other SHA
dirty source, changed candidate, missing authorization, or ambiguous remote ref
sequence.rollback_boundary: Do not rewrite or delete remote history. Stop and retain the published SHA; any revert or corrective publication requires a new explicit authorization.

sequence.name: production adoption/reset
sequence.mutation: Using the existing formal promotion/adoption contract, adopt the published target into the production actor/manifest and perform only the separately authorized publisher activation-only reset if its preconditions pass.
preconditions: exact current actor and manifest digests match the plan
Rule 25 capability/readiness gates PASS where applicable
explicit user authorization for production adoption and reset
success_evidence: actor HEAD and manifest actor_head equal published remote SHA
reset success receipt with correlation, target generation, post-reset identity, and six-other-services-unchanged proof
fail_closed: any identity, digest, generation, lock, stage, queue, state, transaction, or service drift
sequence.rollback_boundary: Use only the formal command's built-in rollback bundle for a failed reset/adoption; do not hand-edit actor, manifest, queue, state, stage, barriers, or LaunchAgents. A rollback receipt is terminal for this execution line and requires new authorization to retry.

sequence.name: fresh read-only authority recheck
sequence.mutation: None. Re-read remote main, production actor, runtime manifest, release observation, and protected mutation surfaces through the formal read-only reconciler.
preconditions: fresh correlation ID and evidence directory
success_evidence: remote SHA equals actor HEAD equals manifest actor_head
fail_closed: any SHA mismatch, stale observation, missing receipt, reconciler BLOCKED, unknown state, or tripwire change
sequence.rollback_boundary: No rollback is performed by a read-only recheck. Preserve all evidence and stop; any corrective mutation needs a new authorization.
